RawComment: The lecturer was excellent and explained complex concepts clearly. I really enjoyed this course.
The professor ignored my emails three times and refused to give feedback on my assignment. Very disappointing service.
As a non-native English speaker, I found the technical terminology very difficult to understand. Please provide a glossary for future courses.
The course materials contain outdated stereotypes about mental health conditions. This is harmful to students with these conditions.
The examples only featured male programmers and the language assumes the reader is male. This is discouraging for female students.
The assignment assumed everyone celebrates Christmas, which doesn't respect my cultural background as a Buddhist student.
All the website links in the course materials are broken. I can't access any of the required readings.
I contacted support about enrollment issues but they transferred me to three different departments. Nobody knew how to help me.
The lab sessions were well-organized and the teaching assistant was knowledgeable and helpful. Great experience overall.
The administrative staff never processed my extension request despite multiple follow-ups. I'm very dissatisfied with this service.
